Job Title 
 Research Scientist 
 
 Agency 
Texas A&M University 
 
 Department 
School of Engineering Medicine 
 
 Proposed Minimum Salary 
 Commensurate 
 
 Job Location 
 Houston, Texas 
 
 Job Type 
 Staff 
 
 Job Description 
 Our Commitment 
 Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service. 

 Who we are 
 As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery. 

 What we want 
 The Research Scientist, under direction by Dustin Green, is responsible for conducting complex independent research in the field of Neuroimmunology. This position supports research focused on unraveling neuroimmune inflammatory pain and itch mechanisms. The Research Scientist will play a critical role in driving daily laboratory operations, with a primary emphasis on in vivo experimental support, behavioral testing, and comprehensive transgenic colony management. The Research Scientist will utilize techniques and strategies taught to them by their education and experiences to work towards solving the question presented by their research project. Writes and may contribute to research papers, articles, and publications. Oversee the preparation and cleaning of worksite. May collaborate with other researchers and/or faculty.

 What you need to kno w
 Please note: This position is grant funded; future employment may be contingent upon future funding. 

 Responsibilities:   
 Research 
 Colony Management: Manage and maintain multiple transgenic mouse lines, including routine genotyping.
 In Vivo Models & Behavior: Assist in executing preclinical mouse models, including multiple behavioral assays.
 Benchwork : Conduct standard molecular and cellular laboratory techniques, including immunochemistry and tissue processing.
 Data Analysis: Record experimental data meticulously and perform preliminary statistical significance testing on biological datasets.
 Laboratory Operations: Maintain laboratory inventory, ensure proper functioning of pain testing equipment, and strictly uphold safety mitigations and compliance standards.
 Assist with grant acquisition.
  
 Mentoring/Supervision 
 May assist student researchers, Postdoctoral Research Associates, Assistant Research Scientists, and/or Associate Research Scientists who are working on research related to the project.
 May supervise assigned staff and/or students.
  
 Presentations: 
 Assist in preparing presentation materials on research topics such as seminars, lab meetings, or poster presentations.
 Actively participates in the preparation of required technical progress reports to research sponsors.
  
 Qualifications 
 Required Education and Experience 
 PhD in a related field.
Six years of related experience in Immunology, neuroscience or related field.
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Familiarity with Flow Cytometry, behavioral assays, tissue sectioning, or immunochemistry
 Prior hands-on experience with rodent handling, breeding, and colony management
  
 Knowledge, Skills, and Ability 
 Excellent verbal and written skills.
 Analytical skills, including use of statistical software (Prism or R).
 Must be able to work independently as part of a multidisciplinary collaborative team.
 Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.
  
 Why Texas A&M University?      
 We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration.  
 Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts , and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums   
 12-15 days of annual paid holidays    
 Up to eight hours of paid sick leave  and at least  eight hours of paid vacation  each month   
 Automatic enrollment in the  Teacher Retirement System of Texas   
 Health and Wellness: Free exercise programs and release time    
 Professional Development: All employees have access to free  LinkedIn Learning  training, webinars, and limited financial support to attend conferences, workshops, and more    
 Educational release time and tuition assistance  for completing a degree while a Texas A&M employee   
 Living Well, a program at Texas A&M that has been built by employees, for employees  
 
 Instructions to Applicants: Applications received by Texas A&M University must either have all job application data entered, or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume or use a LinkedIn profile to pre-populate the online application. 
 
 All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.
 
 Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.
